scope: candidate creation authorization, request consumption, reference reuse prevention, unauthorized candidate quarantine, and production preservation

rootCause.authorityConflation: The former workflow treated reference rights as if they also authorized creation of a new candidate.
rootCause.contractDrift: The former completion rule and TASK-010 promoted an internal end-to-end validation idea into a real user-facing asset-production task.
rootCause.missingMachineGate: The former createCandidate path had no immutable, human-bound, single-use candidate request.

correctiveMechanisms: An immutable candidate-creation request is required before candidate import.
Each request binds one reference SHA-256, assetId, category, rights mode, human actor, timestamp, and maximumCandidates=1.
A successful import consumes the request; repeat consumption is rejected.
Reusing a reference already present in workflow history requires explicit per-request reuse authorization.
No authorized request produces the stable WAITING_FOR_USER_INPUT state.
Unauthorized historical candidates can be removed from the active testing manifest while preserving immutable quarantine evidence.

executedChecks.command: node --check scripts/lib/asset-pipeline.mjs && node --check scripts/asset-pipeline.mjs && node --test tests/asset-pipeline.test.mjs tests/catalog-migration.test.mjs tests/catalog-history.test.mjs tests/no-chroma.test.mjs tests/catalog.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-no-chroma.mjs && node scripts/catalog-release.mjs --check --library testing && node scripts/catalog-release.mjs --check --library production && node scripts/asset-pipeline.mjs status

workflow.nextAction: Wait for the decision owner to provide a new reference image and explicitly request one candidate.

limits: Local confirmed-by-human records are traceable attestations, not cryptographic identity verification.

The canonical Spec-to-Demo baseline and build approvals are superseded by this scope correction and must be renewed against the new exact fingerprints before the corrected contract can be activated and sealed.
No GitHub, Netlify, Figma Community, or other external deployment was performed.
